lines.speaker: sparrow_pilot
lines.text: It's breaking up. It's... it's over.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Finch. Wren. Kite. Twenty minutes ago Nanda was asking about spacing.

lines.speaker: captain
lines.text: One ship. It took one ship to take three of ours.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Then we make sure the next one can't. Something in that wreck is still warm.

lines.speaker: captain
lines.text: Teo, suit up and go across. Moss, log it. Log everything.
